children: Mobix Labs announced Vision Aerial projects ~46% revenue growth in 2026 and ~93% in 2027 as part of its pending acquisition.
Mobix Labs signed a definitive agreement to acquire Vision Aerial; transaction expected to close Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions.
Vision Aerial projects ~46% revenue growth in 2026 and ~93% additional growth in 2027 based on management estimates.
Vision Aerial supplies U.S. Navy, L3Harris and other government, energy and infrastructure customers—supporting NDAA-compliant, American-built drones.
New Vulcan drone family (Vulcan SX and YX) targets industrial, government and national-security missions with extended endurance and professional payloads.
Mobix Labs says the acquisition aligns with its M&A strategy to add differentiated, American-built tech and expand its national-security technology platform.
